audience: Sales and support teams that take calls and voicemails on MightyCall

useCases.title: Review missed and recent calls
useCases.text: List calls in a time window, then open one call to see the caller, the called parties and the call record.

useCases.title: Review new voicemails
useCases.text: List voicemails in a time window, filtered by read state, then open one for its caller, time and duration.

useCases.title: Work through open journal requests
useCases.text: List journal requests by direction, outcome or phone number. Open one to read its state, contacts and comment.

useCases.title: Resolve journal requests after the team handles them
useCases.text: Set one or more journal requests to Resolved, or back to Open. This changes live data in the account.

useCases.title: Check business numbers and your extension
useCases.text: List the business phone numbers, and read the profile of the MightyCall user that the key belongs to.
